description: Asks how identifier and parameter-marker spellings from other systems are read over Dm: a double-quoted or single-quoted name, a #-delimited name, @, : and $ prefixed names, a bare ? marker, a Forms!F!C, TempVars!x and Screen.ActiveForm.Name reference in WHERE, a bang qualifier, a dotted bracket, spaces around the dot, a name starting with a digit, a keyword and a quoted name as alias with and without AS, and a duplicated alias. DAO opens each as a snapshot directly; an unresolved name is read as the call at which it fails and its DBEngine.Errors, never as a prompt. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.

args.text: SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = ?
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = @p
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = :p
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [p]
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = [Forms]![F]![C]
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Forms!F!C
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = TempVars!x
SELECT ID FROM Dm WHERE ID = Screen.ActiveForm.Name
SELECT ID AS From FROM Dm
SELECT ID AS Select FROM Dm
SELECT ID AS x, ID AS x FROM Dm
SELECT ID AS X, ID AS x FROM Dm
SELECT ID AS ID, ID FROM Dm
SELECT ID AS [a b], ID AS [a  b] FROM Dm
